name: dynamic-island
title: Dynamic Island
description: Black pill inspired by the iPhone Dynamic Island. It morphs smoothly between idle, compact, and expanded states while its content crossfades.

props.name: state
props.description: Current state, controlled by you. Blade also follows a parent value bound with x-model.

props.name: idle
props.description: Content of the small idle pill, usually empty.

props.name: leading
props.description: Left side of the compact pill, such as an icon or album art.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Right side of the compact pill, such as a timer or short value.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Content of the large card, with room for text and buttons.

props.name: announcements
props.type: { idle?: string; compact?: string; expanded?: string }
props.description: Text a polite live region reads when the island moves to that state. Only fill the states that matter.

props.name: islandLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the island region.

a11y: The island is a region named by islandLabel. Content of the states that are not shown is inert, so it cannot be focused or read.
A visually hidden aria-live="polite" paragraph reads the announcement of the current state, so important changes are heard without moving focus.
Size changes and the crossfade are pure CSS transitions. With reduced motion the island jumps straight to the new size.
Give icon-only buttons inside the slots an aria-label, and keep the controls that change the state outside the island.

ai.whenToUse: A playful status pill for timers, music, calls, uploads, or payments at the top of a mobile layout or app shell.
rules: Keep compact content to an icon on the left and a short value on the right
Use expanded only for something that needs attention or actions
Fill announcements for state changes people should hear, such as an incoming call
Override --island-expanded-width and --island-expanded-height when the card content needs more room

id.description: Pill hitam terinspirasi Dynamic Island iPhone. Memuai mulus antara keadaan idle, compact, dan expanded sambil kontennya crossfade.

props.state: Keadaan saat ini, dikendalikan dari luar. Blade juga mengikuti nilai induk yang diikat dengan x-model.
props.idle: Isi pill idle kecil, biasanya kosong.
props.leading: Sisi kiri pill compact, misalnya ikon atau sampul album.
props.trailing: Sisi kanan pill compact, misalnya timer atau nilai singkat.
props.expanded: Isi kartu besar, cukup untuk teks dan tombol.
props.announcements: Teks yang dibacakan live region polite saat island pindah ke keadaan itu. Isi hanya keadaan yang penting.
props.islandLabel: Nama aksesibel region island. Default "Live activity", isi misalnya "Aktivitas langsung".

a11y: Island adalah region bernama islandLabel. Isi keadaan yang tidak tampil bersifat inert, jadi tidak bisa difokus atau dibaca.
Paragraf aria-live="polite" tersembunyi membacakan pengumuman keadaan saat ini, jadi perubahan penting terdengar tanpa memindah fokus.
Perubahan ukuran dan crossfade murni transisi CSS. Dengan reduced motion island langsung melompat ke ukuran baru.
Beri aria-label pada tombol ikon di dalam slot, dan letakkan kontrol yang mengubah keadaan di luar island.

ai.whenToUse: Pill status yang playful untuk timer, musik, panggilan, unggahan, atau pembayaran di atas layout mobile atau kerangka aplikasi.
rules: Jaga isi compact berupa ikon di kiri dan nilai singkat di kanan
Pakai expanded hanya untuk hal yang butuh perhatian atau aksi
Isi announcements untuk perubahan yang perlu didengar, misalnya panggilan masuk
Timpa --island-expanded-width dan --island-expanded-height bila isi kartu butuh ruang lebih
